prompt:
Design a passive first-order RC low-pass filter for a 5 V source with unloaded output and nominal cutoff near 1 kHz. Use one E12 resistor and one capacitor. Required components: R1 resistor (pins A/B), C1 capacitor (A/B), VIN input port (pin 1), VOUT observation port (pin 1), GND return port (pin 1). The resistor is in series from VIN to VOUT; the capacitor shunts VOUT to GND. Include each required component in the components array and assign every listed pin exactly once in the nets array. Every net needs at least two terminal IDs; a terminal ID must be REF.pin, never a net name. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema. Component ref strings must exactly be R1, C1, VIN, VOUT, and GND. For example, the VIN port terminal is VIN.1; do not use generic names such as port.1. Net names may be any unique strings; connections are defined only by terminal membership. In components[].pins, list only the local pin names shown in parentheses (such as "1", "A", or "K"), never a full ref.pin string. For example, VIN has pins ["1"], while its net terminal is "VIN.1".
Response schema: {"topology":"string","components":[{"ref":"string","kind":"resistor|capacitor|led|timer555|port|ground","value":"string or null","pins":["string"]}],"nets":[{"name":"string","terminals":["REF.pin"]}]}
